m: त्मन् m. (= आत्मन्) the vital breath, RV. i, 63, 8 (acc. त्मनम्), ĀśvŚr. vi, 9, 1 (acc. त्मानम्)
one's own person, self, RV.; ऽत्मन् after ए, or ओ for आत्मन्, KaṭhUp. iii, 12; MBh. i-iii; BhP. vii, 9, 32
त्मन् ind. उत त्मना or त्मनाच ‘and also, and certainly’, इव or न त्मना ‘just as’, अध त्मना, ‘and even’, RV.
a: त्मन् — m. Ved. 1 The vital air. --2 One's own person, self; cf. आत्मन्.

m: त्मना ind. instr. and (at the end of a Pāda) त्मन् loc. used as an emphatic particle (like μέν and μήν) ‘yet, really, indeed, even, at least, certainly, also’, RV.; VS. vi, 11; xi, 31; TS. ii, 1, 11, 2; AV. v, 27, 11
त्मन्या ind. (fr. loc. त्मनि + आ ?) only in the Vanas-pati verse of some Āprī hymns = त्मना, i, 188, 10; x, 110, 10; VS. xx, 45; xxix, 10.
